+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M21AHDHY0H7A92PP2KTRTZEZ
+- 01M21AHYBMNR7CNDZRPMWRTRTY
+- 01M21AK7DBCBMDHK82JY5RA063
+- 01M21AHNHX7YF6D4268FQ3K3YA
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: a580
+title: 'Accessibility: linked reading groups, VoiceOver boundary announcements, focus moves, Reduce Motion, Dynamic Type (plan §6, research R11)'
+---
+## What
+Create `Sources/AgentViewKit/Accessibility/ThreadAccessibility.swift` and `Announcer.swift`, and apply them across the item views, per plan.md §6. This task settles research R11.
+
+- `accessibilityLinkedGroup(id:in:)`: one group per message across its paragraph views, and one per thread across message rows, with a `@Namespace` owned by `AgentThreadView`.
+- `Announcer`: posts `AccessibilityNotification.Announcement` only at boundaries: turn complete, tool result, action required. Never per chunk. Priority high for action required.
+- Focus: `@AccessibilityFocusState` moves to a new pending card and back to the composer on resolve (the `PendingRequestsHost` hook).
+- Reduce Motion: `ShimmerView`, glass morphing, and streaming text animation check `accessibilityReduceMotion` and snap to the final state.
+- Dynamic Type: every kit font uses a text style. Check that EditorKit code blocks scale with `\.editorLineHeight` from the current text style; record the result and, if EditorKit does not scale, file an EditorKit task.
+- Labels: tool calls "<title>, <status>"; reasoning "Reasoning, in progress" or "Reasoning, N seconds"; diffs "<language> diff, +A −R".
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The accessibility tree shows one linked group per message.
+- [ ] Ten chunks produce zero announcements; turn completion produces one.
+- [ ] Focus moves to a new permission card and returns to the composer after the answer.
+- [ ] With Reduce Motion, no animation modifiers are applied (verify through a test environment flag).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Accessibility/ThreadAccessibilityHostedTests.swift`: groups, announcements through an injected announcer, focus, reduce motion.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
